title: Monitoring Progress of Waste-to-landfill and Solar Energy Deployment Targets in Singapore Green Plan 2030
what_it_is: Monitoring Progress of Waste-to-landfill and Solar Energy Deployment Targets in Singapore Green Plan 2030

sections.label: Waste, landfill and solar targets
sections.summary: Singapore set waste-to-landfill reduction targets under the Green Plan 2030 and is on track for its 2025 solar deployment target.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Under the Singapore Green Plan 2030, we had set targets to reduce the amount of waste sent to the Semakau Landfill by 20% by 2026 and 30% by 2030, on a per capita per day basis, from our baseline in 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: While our domestic waste generated per capita and non-domestic waste generated per dollar gross domestic product have decreased over the past decade, our waste-to-landfill per capita per day remains about the same as the pre-pandemic baseline in 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: This is largely because recycling rates have dropped due to challenges, such as higher freight costs, import restrictions by foreign countries and lower demand for recycled materials.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: We will continue to strengthen our efforts and work with stakeholders to reduce waste, close the waste loop and extend the lifespan of Semakau Landfill.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: These include working with the industry to roll out the beverage container return scheme in 2026 and exploring the use of landfilled mixed materials as reclamation fill.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: On solar energy, we are on track to meeting our 2025 target of 1.5 gigawatt-peak of deployment.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: As of June 2024, we have achieved 1.35 gigawatt-peak of deployment, which can meet around 2% of Singapore's annual electricity demand.

sections.label: JTC industrial solar rooftops
sections.summary: Since 2017, JTC has installed the Solar Roof Programme to accelerate solar panel installation on industrial property rooftops.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: For the industrial sectors, since 2017, JTC has installed the Solar Roof Programme and that aims to accelerate the installation of solar panels on industrial properties' rooftops.

sections.label: Singapore emissions efforts and Trump
sections.summary: Singapore will continue working with like-minded countries and persevere with targets and efforts to curb global emissions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: On Mr Ang's point about the impact on global efforts to contain emissions with the new term of the Trump administration, indeed, we are observing.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: We do see challenges ahead, but Singapore will continue to work with like-minded countries and persevere with these targets and efforts to curb global emissions.
